body:
[A10] Assignment: one lane for #125 and #122. Both are processor contract text derived from kebag-logic/milan-fpga#509. Executor [A348]; reviewers [R342] (internal) and [R343] (external). Branch `125-ownership-contract` from `main` at `493e5e4b`. One PR closes both. No code change.

**#125:** do acceptance items 1-4. Start from the proposed wording in the #509 author handoff (section "Processor contract wording"; the parent evidence branch `509-review-evidence` holds the packet). Update it for `493e5e4b`: the packer now refuses body type/index disagreement with the directory key. Every "does not enforce" statement must be true at `493e5e4b`; check each one against `hdl/aecp/desc/gen_desc_image.py` and the lint.

**#122 (F07.2 minimum against the parent's zero-cluster inputs):**
- F07.2 draws `STREAM_PORT_INPUT "1" *-- "1..*" AUDIO_CLUSTER_IN`.
- The parent's 8x8 STREAM_PORT_INPUTs own zero clusters (parent decision D8; `docs/reference/PP_DESCRIPTOR_OWNERSHIP.md` notes the discrepancy).

Decision rule. Find the governing clauses: Milan §5.3.3 (STREAM_PORT_INPUT / AUDIO_CLUSTER) and IEEE 1722.1 STREAM_PORT descriptor `number_of_clusters`. Use the parent's `docs/spec-refs.md` extract; never load a spec PDF.
- **If the standard permits zero clusters** on a STREAM_PORT_INPUT: correct F07.2's multiplicity to `0..*`, cite the clause at the diagram and in the lint table, and say what a zero-cluster port means (dynamic mapping has no target).
- **If the standard requires one or more:** STOP. Report on #122 with the clause text reference. Do not edit F07.2 to match the parent; the parent is then non-conforming, and that is a parent decision.

Do not infer a waiver from successful packing.

Gates: the processor's docs gates from `.github/workflows`, `scripts/check-links.py`, `scripts/gen_matrix.py --check` (if present) and `git diff --check`. All rc 0.

[A10] Correction to the #122 decision rule: the parent has no `docs/spec-refs.md` extract. Extract only the clauses you cite, with `pdftotext -f <page> -l <page>` into a scratch directory, from the local copies of the Milan specification and IEEE 1722.1-2021. Quote the clause number and the relevant sentence in the PR. Do not commit or publish any standard text beyond a short citation.

[A348] REVIEW READY

Head: `1d249e6e18a91c16a2620904483634548b0414a6`
Branch: `125-ownership-contract` (base `493e5e4bf58a6146bf9310194d71c72e18610704`).

One local documentation commit covers #125 and the #122 clause disposition. F07.2 retains `1..*`: Milan §5.3.3.8 requires at least one AUDIO_CLUSTER per Stream Port Input. The STOP report is [on #122](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/122#issuecomment-5853884588); the parent D8 discrepancy remains a parent decision.

All documentation gates, link and generated-matrix checks, and whitespace checks returned 0. Existing body/key checks passed; targeted L6/L10 observations support the documented enforcement gaps. HANDOFF.md and PR-BODY.md are complete in the assigned output directory. Working tree clean; no push or PR creation.
